project.name: Primitive
release_notes: AES-GCM can admit an independently owned cipher borrow before an external effect, preserving sealing authority through source shutdown without exporting key bytes.
Ordinary cipher aliases still share destruction. Every admitted borrow retains the same native key schedule until its own explicit Destroy; native nonce limits remain shared across the key.

Native race and lifetime proof covers source, alias, sibling and concurrent Borrow/Destroy ownership. A one-fact shared-state control fails both independence contracts; scoped AES-GCM analyzers are clean.
